scene returntosummer1
: Finally! Maya and I have been waiting here for hours for you guys to get back!
: It’s probably only been around forty-five minutes, but you get the point.
: I...had no idea you two were even going to be here.
scene returntosummer2
: What, really? Did none of my texts go through or something? I’ve been writing to Ami about it like all day.
scene returntosummer3
: That’s weird. I haven’t gotten anything.
: But I probably wouldn’t have answered even if I did since Sensei and I were having so much fun.
scene returntosummer4
: Oh, okay. Okay. So that’s how it’s going to be, Ami. Fine.
: Sensei. Come with me. We’re going to take a bath together.
: Alternatively, you could be slightly decent and remain here instead of debauching your home with your [niece] and the local shrine maiden right outside the bathroom door.
: For everyone’s safety, I think I’m going to go with Maya’s suggestion and take a rain check on the...shared bathing experience.
scene returntosummer5
: So, what did you two do all day? I stopped by earlier this morning to say hi and no one was here, so I’m guessing you guys were pretty busy.
: I also stopped by, but it was just to eat your food. I am not sorry.
: I’ll call the locksmith in the morning.
: Thanks, Ami.
: We just kind of wandered around the entertainment district and went out to eat. Nothing special.
Apart from the trip to the graveyard, of course. But I doubt anyone here wants to hear about that.
scene returntosummer6
: I made Sensei come with me to the manga shop so I could get the new volume of My Sweet Prince.
: Ew.
: What’s that? I don’t know that one.
: It’s probably best if you don’t look into it.
scene returntosummer7
: You starting to get into the weird stuff, Ami? I knew it was only a matter of time.
: There is nothing weird about the purest form of love there is.
: What? Why are you just looking at me?
: I was hoping there was a part of you who also felt like this situation was beginning to get a bit too awkward, but I realize now that I was mistaken in believing that was possible.
scene black
I return to the door to lock it and prevent anyone else from randomly showing up before returning to the living room to join the girls on the couch.
scene returntosummer8
: Are you excited to finally have summer back, Sensei? I know you get really depressed when you have to go long periods of time without seeing my exposed thighs.
: And I know that Sensei thinks your thighs could be a little slimmer. He told me earlier today.
: That’s not a thing I said.
: You don’t have to actually say it because I always know what you’re thinking.
: I’m not really excited to have summer back, but I do welcome the change. One more week of the cold and I probably would have died.
scene returntosummer9
: Right?! I feel exactly the same!
: Oh! And I forgot to tell you- I was talking to Touka earlier and she told me about how you and her family went out to do summery stuff together but you had no idea where to go.
: Why didn’t you just ask me? I’m basically the queen of summer! I would have shown you guys everything there is to know!
: Which is?
: You know!...Summer stuff!
scene returntosummer10
: Ami knows what I’m talking about! Right, Ami?
: Huh? Oh! Uhh...yeah! Summer! Woo!
scene returntosummer11
: Yeah! Woo!
: So, after the whole summer thing, Touka and I got to talking about more stuff and thought it might be cool if we could like, throw a pool party at her place sometime.
: I highly doubt they’d let over twenty “commoners” in at once, Ayane.
scene returntosummer12
: You must be forgetting that I’m rich, Sensei. And since I’d be a guest of honor, I get a plus-twenty.
: That is significantly more than the plus-one you’d get under normal circumstances.
: Different rules apply to rich people. And while I don’t like to flaunt them that much, I know when to use my powers.
: I’ll go. I probably won’t swim, but I’m assuming there will be a banquet of some sort.
scene returntosummer13
: How about you, Ami? Ready to get your vacation on at the biggest mansion in Kumon-mi?
: From what I’ve heard, it makes my place look like-
scene returntosummer14
: Ami?
: Is...everything okay?...
scene returntosummer15
: Hm? What? Of course. Why wouldn’t it be?
: Well...you just kinda zoned out for a second...
scene returntosummer16
: Oh! Hahaha...yeah.
: Guess it was a...long...
scene returntosummer17
: Actually...sorry! I’m gonna lay down. I don’t...feel too good...
: Do you...need tea or something? Medicine? I’ll go to the store for you!
: I’m okay! Just...have fun without me!
scene black
Ami heads back into her room and the three of us are left mildly confused, but more worried than anything else.
I’ve only seen Ami get sick once in the...roughly four cycles worth of time I’ve spent here. Which I guess would be around a year, maybe?
And even then I feel like her sickness was just an excuse to try and get closer to me.
Things are different this time, though.
Something seems wrong.
scene returntosummer18
: Should we...maybe do something? Like...call a doctor?
: Where did you two go out to eat? Do you think it could be food poisoning?
: I think it’s best if we just...let her rest...
scene returntosummer19
: If she needed our help, she would have asked Sensei to come with her. She probably just wants to be left alone.
: Well...should we go home, then? I don’t think we should stay around if it’s going to disturb her.
: Let's just step outside for a few minutes. Some fresh air would probably be good anyway.
scene returntosummer20
: Mm...I guess she probably would have asked for Sensei if it was actually bad...
: Okay. We can go out for some fresh air. But if Ami doesn’t want us to be here when we come back in-
: We’ll walk home together. I know...
scene black
Ayane and Maya make their way over to the door.
I attempt to follow them but stop in front of Ami’s for some reason.
Inside, I can faintly hear the sound of-
: Sensei! Leave Ami alone for now! We can check on her in a little bit.
I follow Ayane outside.
scene returntosummer21
: Ahh! The fresh, pre-summer air! If only I could bottle some of it up and take it back to the dorms with me.
: What exactly differentiates “pre-summer” air from regular summer air?
: Can you really not feel a difference?
: Pre-summer air is like, a million times lighter. Like, it’s chilly...but not so chilly that you need to put a jacket on.
: In summer, it’s like...I don’t know. A few steps away from that?
scene returntosummer22
: Anyway, did the whole pool party thing sound okay to you, Sensei?
: Uta would normally be my go-to girl to plan something like this, but nobody seems to be able to get a hold of her today.
: I’m like, one or two steps away from asking Makoto to help out. Which doesn’t mean I have anything against Makoto or anything, but-
scene returntosummer23
: Hey, random question. Are you pregnant?
: Maya-
: Sorry...what did you just say?
: “Hey, random question. Are you pregnant?”
scene returntosummer24
: So...is this like...
: Some kind of joke? Or...
: Probably. And Maya clearly isn’t very well-versed when it comes to comedy, so-
: I’m being 100%% serious. And I need to know right now.
: What do you mean you need to know right-
scene returntosummer25
: I mean that we are running out of time and I need to know right now. Immediately. This very instant.
: How many more ways do you need me to express the urgency of this? Because I’m starting to run out of patience.
: How...
: I mean, how could I be pregnant? I don’t have anyone who I-
scene returntosummer26
: Sensei, obviously. Which you shouldn’t be that surprised to hear I know about since you two have been screwing each other basically all school year.
: Maya, leave her alone. Ayane didn’t do anything-
: Blah blah blah. I don’t need to know who did what. I just need to know if there’s a...thing growing inside of her.
scene returntosummer27
: Go back inside.
: Do you...think you can give me orders? I am literally doing this for you.
: Everyone could disappear at literally any second right now, and as the person who’s basically responsible for bringing everyone back, I kind of need to know who to wait around for.
: Wait...around for? What does that mean?
: It doesn’t mean anything and you shouldn’t have to worry about it.
: Did you really have to pick now to start playing white knight? It would be such an easy question for her to answer if you’d just let her speak.
scene returntosummer28
: Maya, please don’t tell anyone else about Sensei and me. If word gets out about this and he loses his job, I’ll-
: I’m not interested in spreading rumors about who’s sleeping with who. I literally just need to know if you’re pregnant. That’s it.
: You don’t have to answer that, Ayane.
scene returntosummer29
: Jesus fucking Christ! Can you let me talk to her without interrupting for a fucking second, please?!
: You mean like how you interrupted us to invade her privacy?
: Oh, excuse me for trying to protect you! We need to go back to doing things the way they need to be done or you’ll...I’ll wind up alone again!
: And since when do you care about anyone’s privacy? You basically make a living by walking in on girls as they’re getting dressed.
: Guys...
: I’m just saying that there’s a right way and a wrong way to do this and just jumping on her is wrong.
: Are you forgetting that you’re the one who told me this was a possibility? Or is jumping on Ayane something only you’re permitted to do and I have to submit a fucking application for it?
: Guys...stop yelling...Ami’s window is right there...
: I wouldn’t have told you anything if I knew you were going to try and pull intimate information out of her like it’s something as meaningless as a favorite color.
: Children might be unimportant or insignificant to us, but Ayane wants one more than anything in the world.
: Then she should be excited to share the joyous news of her impending burden with me.
: Guys!
: Maya-
: Listen to me. Your [niece] is probably inside fucking disintegrating right now. And I need to know if there are going to be any surprises on the roof this time before it’s too late.
: And if Ayane is pregnant, then what?
scene returntosummer30
: Then what, Maya?
: I’m not pregnant!
scene returntosummer31
: I’m not...pregnant...
: How sure are you? When was your last period? When was the last time you two-
: I’m...really sure, Maya.
: I check every time he...you know.
scene returntosummer32
: I’m sure it probably sounds crazy, but...I’ve been kind of hoping to get pregnant. That’s why I’m always checking.
: Yes, that sounds absolutely insane.
: I’m just...really excited to be a mom one day. More than anything in the-
: Okay, Ayane. I am...flattered that this is information you suddenly want to share with me, but I really just needed a yes or no answer.
: It’s done. I apologize for the spontaneity of the question, but it was very important to figure this out now rather than later.
scene returntosummer33
: What’s...going on?...
: I’m still trying to process the fact that you even know about us, but...what was up with all of that other stuff you said?
: ...hah. I guess there’s no harm in telling you since you’ll probably forget it by tomorrow anyway.
: Forget what? What are you talking about?
scene black
Maya moves toward Ayane while I remain in place.
I’m relieved to hear that I can go one more day without being a father, but...
Hearing Ayane putting to words the death of her dream makes it hard for me to walk.
It makes it hard for me to do anything really.
So I remain in place.
I become a statue.
And I watch in irony as everything but me crumbles to pieces.
scene returntosummer34
: Random question part two- the less depressing version.
: Do you remember anything about a particular group hug you may have shared on the rooftop of the school recently? Or the disappearance of virtually your entire class?
: Rooftop? No, but...
scene returntosummer35
: Sensei...didn’t you ask me the same question a few months ago? Along with some...sleepover that I apparently skipped out on?
: ...yeah. It was the same night you said you lost something.
Which...I’m just now starting to understand the meaning of.
The pit that sprouted roots in my stomach earlier is now a full grown tree.
Each second carves a new marking into it.
scene returntosummer36
: So, basically, all of us are caught in an infinite time loop and, up until recently, I was the only one who was aware of this.
: Sensei, who was not Sensei for a very long time, is now Sensei again.
: We need to make it up to the roof and hug in order to turn time back and if you were pregnant, it might not work.
: Now you know everything. Enjoy it for the next few hours before it’s wiped away along with any memory of this conversation.
scene returntosummer37
: So...since Maya isn’t telling me, can you fill me in on what’s actually going on, Sensei?
: I don’t know what kind of response I expected out of that...
: It’s probably best to just...not think about it, Ayane. It’s getting late and I don’t want you crying any more than you already have.
: Sensei...
: Why did you tell Maya about us?...
: Because-
: Because I’m mean and I bullied him into telling me, just like how I bullied you.
: I’m just a big jerk and everyone can blame everything on me because that is both the easiest scenario and the least overall time consuming.
scene returntosummer38
: And you...promise you’re not going to tell anyone about this?
: What I promise doesn’t really matter since you probably won’t even remember me making the promise, but sure.
: I have nothing to gain from telling anyone and...significantly much more to lose.
: Your disgusting secret is safe with me, Ayane.
scene returntosummer39
: Hey.
: Oh, shut up.
: This is all still...really...really weird...but as long as that secret’s safe, I’m happy.
: Well, not as happy as I would be if I really was pregnant. But happy that I can continue to have sex with Sensei without having to worry about Maya finding out.
: Did you hear the sentence I just had to process because you wouldn’t let Ayane just answer a fucking yes or no question without getting in the way?
: This is going to sound rich coming from me, but I’d appreciate it if you would think of each other’s feelings a little more often.
: Yeah. That sounds very rich. And wrong.
scene returntosummer40
: I feel like we should all hug. I still don’t get it, but I think we just went through a very emotional, dynamic-changing moment together.
: Or we can...not hug?
: It’s okay, Maya. I’m not pregnant so you won’t crush the baby.
scene returntosummer41
: Okay. I’m done here.
: Wait, I’ll come with you. I want to check on Ami anyway.
: Are you really okay, Ayane?
scene returntosummer42
: No.
: But I will be.
: I’m sure everything will be fine in the morning.
scene black
: Me too.
scene returntosummer43
: How come you’re the quiet one all of a sudden, Maya? This is supposed to be my time to act all depressed and stuff.
: I’m almost always the quiet one. There was just a notable exception tonight since the world’s most worthless teacher decided to push my buttons at the worst possible time.
scene returntosummer44
: You can push my buttons any time you want, Sensei. And by buttons I mean-
: I know what you mean, Ayane.
: I’m glad I’m theoretically only going to have to put up with one night of this.
scene returntosummer43
: Oh. Should we maybe make some soup for Ami or something? Do we have a cold compress? What about...ginger?
: I have no idea what’s wrong with her so I’m just going to do a little bit of everything and hope that something works.
: What part of “leave her alone” did you not understand?
: Obviously the “leave her alone” part. She’s my best friend and it’s my duty to take care of her when she’s not feeling well.
scene returntosummer44
: I’m going to make tea. Sensei, do you want any? Or will you feel obligated to impregnate me out of gratitude?
: I’m sorry Ayane, but I can’t imagine feeling “obligated” to do that...ever.
scene black
: I’ll have some tea, though.
scene returntosummer45
I return to the bedroom and prepare for what may or may not be my last slumber before-
: Wait, Sensei! You forgot to tell me what kind you wanted!
: Any type is fine, Ayane. I really don’t care.
: What? I can’t hear you!
: I said-
: What?! You’re going to have to speak up-
scene black
: I said I’m fine with-

My feet sink into the floor and an air of concern CALLOUSNESS washes over me.
I do not know why they sink, for I would never leave this place if given the option anyway.
If this is some preventative measure to keep me from leaving, I can assure you it is unnecessary.
But do you know what is necessary?
: WHERE IS MY TEA????
That darn Ayane- too busy trying to be inseminated to do her job!

And don’t even get me started about that Maya girl. She’s a whoooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

A mass of white flesh or at least a flesh-like substance appears before me.
I can not see its entirety, but my stomach drops regardless.
It is not our first meeting, yet I can’t recall what was.
Somewhere in the back of my mind, a blurred memory attempts to escape only to be cut down by a thick tendril protruding from the center of the white mass.
It fucks my brain like the tight, nubile vagina of the girl who willingly erodes her sanity for a chance at happiness alongside a man who does not deserve it.

Before me, in reverse, is a medley of catastrophe.
I float downward and the world flips, teaching me that having wings alone does not make one an expert at flying.
The song of skin slapping skin severs the smallest semblance of silence this cesspool of salvation spreads out before me.
And in the midst of my uncertainty and the summit of my fear, I understand what it means to be whole and why I slice myself into pieces every single morning.
What is buried can not be unearthed.
And what has been unearthed will never be the same.
